latest_release.body:
<!-- cliproxyapi-linux-release-assets:start -->
## Linux release assets

- `CLIProxyAPI_<version>_linux_<arch>.tar.gz` is the default Linux build. It supports dynamic library plugins and is built against a GLIBC 2.17 baseline.
- `CLIProxyAPI_<version>_linux_<arch>_no-plugin.tar.gz` is the portable Linux build for musl-based or older systems such as OpenWrt. It does not support dynamic library plugins.

## FreeBSD release assets

- `CLIProxyAPI_<version>_freebsd_aarch64_no-plugin.tar.gz` is the FreeBSD arm64 build. It is built without CGO and does not support dynamic library plugins.

<!-- cliproxyapi-linux-release-assets:end -->

## Changelog

- docs(readme): mention cpa-status in Hermes entry (418b824c)
- docs(readme): add SWE-2 Flash to Devin models (59a2b353)

- fix(codex): defer SIWC renewal during macOS maintenance wakes (8c6d8b18)
- fix(auth): retain partition failures alongside SIWC wake cancellation (baec297f)
- test(codex): make SIWC power-state checks deterministic (03c394ee)
- fix(codex): retain SIWC renewal windows in refresh receipts (a46be7ae)
- Merge pull request #7306 from kdcokenny/docs/swe-2-flash-availability (0e071088)
- feat(plugin-store): support opt-in release cache refresh on store listing (f69db99d)
- Merge branch 'codex/pr-7311' into dev (466b28da)

- fix(responses): sanitize orphan tool outputs lacking call_id (05e668cf)
- feat(auth): support session-affinity-rebind-on never mode (40c16182)

- Merge pull request #7281 from duu261/docs/readme-cpa-status (681ce41b)

detail.readme_excerpt:
# CLI Proxy API English | [中文](README_CN.md) | [日本語](README_JA.md) If you want to use CLIProxyAPI on your desktop, we recommend our [EasyCLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/EasyCLIProxyAPI) desktop client. It provides a graphical configuration UI, automatic updates, system tray integration, and one-click start/stop for the CLIProxyAPI service. CLIProxyAPI is a proxy server that provides OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex/Grok compatible API interfaces for CLI. You can access the following providers locally and with multiple CLI accounts through any OpenAI (including Responses), Gemini (including Interactions), or Claude-compatible client or SDK.
Provider Description
Kimi series models (Kimi K3.1 Pro, K3.1 Pro Highspeed, K3, K2.8 Preview, etc.). Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI’s previous-generation flagship and the world’s first open 3T-class model. With 2.8 trillion parameters, native vision, and a 1-million-token context window, K3 is built for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning. CLIProxyAPI supports Kimi through OAuth or compatible API interfaces. Try a Kimi Code plan (中文站 | Global), or get an API key from the Kimi Open Platform (中文站 | Global). Thanks to Kimi for supporting CLIProxyAPI and the open-source community!
OpenAI GPT-6 models (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Luna), including access through Codex OAuth. Astra is the flagship for complex reasoning and coding, Sol balances capability and cost, Terra focuses on visual reasoning and computer use, and Luna handles focused, high-volume work.
Anthropic Claude models (Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5). Fable 5.1 is built for ambitious, long-running coding and knowledge work; Opus 5.5 brings strong agentic coding at a lower cost.
